name: Unsloth
summary: Desktop app, web UI and Python package to run and fine-tune LLMs, diffusion, embedding and audio models locally.
description: Local tool for running and training AI models: LLMs, MLX, GGUF, diffusion, embedding, audio and vision models. Ships as a native desktop app, a Docker web UI (Studio) and a Python package (Core), with an OpenAI-compatible API, MCP tooling, private search/RAG and fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, RL, GRPO, DPO, FP8) that is 2x faster with 70% less VRAM.
contains: desktop app, Docker web UI and Python package
run and train LLMs, diffusion, embedding, audio and vision models
fine-tuning support: LoRA, QLoRA, full fine-tuning, RL, GRPO, DPO, FP8
dual-licensed: Apache-2.0 core, AGPL-3.0 Studio UI
